video.title: Stop Using ChatGPT for This: The Rise of AI Fraud

summary: A short promo clip from Dark Horse Entrepreneur warning micro-business builders that some 'AI money' schemes are outright fraud, citing voice-clone and deepfake scams (a mother losing $15,000, a finance employee wiring $25 million) and long prison sentences for perpetrators. The speaker argues the legitimate opportunity is the trust problem fraud leaves behind: small businesses that help creators, coaches and brands prove their voice, content or identity is real. It is a teaser for a longer episode and gives no operator data.
